title: Member-Owned Sidebar XiaoJ with 8D No-Plaintext Context
title_zh: 會員專屬側邊欄小J與八維無明文上下文
core_sentence_zh: 本會提供無明文上下文與8D安全瀏覽器，小J真正屬於會員；會員可用自己的KEY與API，把雲端AI變成受保護、可節費、可治理的個人代理。本會看統計，不看個資。

dimensions.D1_identity: member_ref / merchant_ref / committee_ref / device_ref / role; no plaintext identity by default
dimensions.D2_intent: query / browser assistance / life knowledge / form drafting / ordering / repair / announcement / summary
dimensions.D3_state: session / sidebar / page access mode / member service / task state
dimensions.D4_topology: member browser / side panel / counter / merchant / committee / site / channel / device
dimensions.D5_resource: system/member/merchant/committee key_ref, api_ref, model tier, cache, tools, cost policy
dimensions.D6_governance: allowed/forbidden actions, no plaintext, no direct backend write, confirmation rules
dimensions.D7_verification: redaction check, leak check, allowlist check, response verify, usage logging
dimensions.D8_envelope: nonce, counter, TTL, hash, HMAC/signature, key_ref/api_ref binding, replay protection
